errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите с предизвикателства
errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart, where the categories are listed on the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis represents the values.
The percentages (values) are represented on the horizontal axis, while the categories are on the vertical axis.
The value axis (horizontal axis) does not have a label. The percentage symbol (%) is part of the data labels for each bar, but the axis itself is not labeled.
The value axis has no visible tick marks or numerical intervals. The description hallucinates the presence of 10% intervals.
The bars in the chart are light blue, not grey.
